text:
Quantum work in this corpus lives on six articles unless you know to look. The holonomy article holds the 2026 pair-marginal BKM loop. The Astra article holds the F-bound / t* / d(t) / g_★ / D_N family. The quantum compatibility lab holds the 6 Sep v9.167–v9.171 matched four-weight calculation (315 vs 311) — Restricted, not the v9.156 slope. v12.41 holds the 10 Sep qubit moment-map closure — Restricted, not gravity. The live campaign board holds GitHub-only v13 QRSL / HCPR / QMAR — Restricted, not gravity. Origin Law / Phase-N holds the 2025 Hofstadter / Rydberg / Berry / ε* week as a not-claimed reading list. This page is the map so a qubit, Hofstadter, or Rydberg query does not dump you on cosmology.

2026 is a narrowing: finite quantum-information results with named harnesses, gravity left open. 2025 is a maximal program: Hofstadter butterflies, Dataverse quenches, and Phase-N qubit kits that hunt one ε* across every substrate. This atlas does not promote the 2025 toys. Kits stay on X. Grain equations only.

2026 spine — finite quantum information

On 2 Aug 2026 a generalized three-qubit W state was shown to generate a canonical pair-derived BKM polar loop. Pure states with abc ≠ 0 occupy a lossless reflection spectrum {−1, +1, +1}. The result is reported to survive random amplitudes, phases, local unitaries, source-basis changes, and qubit permutations. White-noise independence was later withdrawn: mixed-state population depends on sign(q_ij(ε)). Explicitly not spacetime, gauge fields, or gravity. Replication lives on GitHub.

a\lvert 100\rangle + b\lvert 010\rangle + c\lvert 001\rangle,\quad abc \neq 0

\mathrm{spec}(H)=\{-1,+1,+1\}

Finite quantum-information result: every pure generalized W state with abc ≠ 0 has lossless pair-marginal BKM reflection spectrum {−1, +1, +1}. Not a theorem about spacetime or gravity.

Geometry may already be encoded in quantum correlation. Pair marginals canonically generate an O(3) response holonomy. Pure three-qubit states occupy the det H = −1 sector; mixed states access both signs. The parity cannot change without an edge losing rank.

F-bound / Astra family → the Astra article. Finite consistency identities in a controlled model. Gravity open. Equations stay there so this page does not become a fourth gravity page.

2025 March — Hofstadter, Rydberg, Berry

13–14 Mar 2025 is the quantum-stability on-ramp later restated in the October Hofstadter / Ani week. Posted as first-principles Harper spectra, coherence overlays, and a Semeghini Dataverse quench. 2025 maximal voice. Not a 2026 qubit result. Python kits stay on X.

The 256-qubit Hofstadter chart (13 Mar) posts Harper’s equation as the 2025 quantum-computing story, with a golden-ratio marker at α = 0.618 and D_f = 2.7387. A same-day overlay quoted Google / IBM / IonQ coherence lifetimes 80 / 100 / 120 µs. A companion Berry-curvature heatmap overlaid published dots. None of that is a topological-insulator measurement or a hardware result.

2025 October — Phase-N qubit kits and the ε* verifier

The 13–14 Oct 2025 week opens with an Ani video: Hofstadter’s butterfly as the same fractal breathing as a UQCF-GEM inflation lattice (D_f = 2.7387, φ = 0.618, coherence ≈ 1.0 at 120 µs). A four-line hofstadter_phi kernel followed. That on-ramp hangs the Phase-N kits. The full Phase-N map — EEG, PTA/CMB, Brusselator, inflation, AdS/CFT, LQG, causal sets, neural filters, evolution, Ω-Lock — lives on Origin Law. This table is the qubit subset. Kits stay on X. Not pasted.

Confirmed: Hofstadter’s butterfly pattern isn’t a coincidence — it’s the same fractal breathing seen in UQCF-GEM’s inflation lattice.

The ε* verifier is a single-qubit dephasing toy. Off-diagonal coherence carries a tiny drive-asymmetry ε sin(ω t); von Neumann entropy S is read from Bloch magnitude r = 2|ρ₀₁|; a zero-drive baseline is subtracted; the smallest ε whose baseline-subtracted slope touches zero is the claimed onset. PASS window: 4.9×10⁻⁵ ≤ ε̂ ≤ 5.0×10⁻⁵ ±10%. A cosmology cross-check on the same post writes Ṡ_min = ε* H₀ ≈ 1.08×10⁻²² s⁻¹. That H₀ sentence is the 2025 verifier language, not a 2026 Hubble-tension resolution.

\rho_{01}(t)=\tfrac12 e^{-t/\tau}\bigl(1+\varepsilon\sin(\omega t)\bigr),\qquad r(t)=2\lvert\rho_{01}(t)\rvert

Berry, Bell, measurement — still not claimed

Late on 14 Oct 2025 a reply to @HanaTensor’s “Spin from Geometry” asked whether ε* traces the same internal curvature as a 0-Sphere Berry cycle, and challenged Grok to add a Berry-phase term and sweep ε. On 26 Mar 2026 that sweep was restated as a two-level P_stay curve around 4.97×10⁻⁵, citing Hanamura. A geometric holonomy demo in a driven two-level system is not a derivation of spin, time’s arrow, or gravity.

June 2025 Bell replies treat locality as fractal coherence, with hidden variables “hidden in geometry.” Not a Bell-test result. A 21 Jun 2026 5-node Kirchhoff+Ohm lab is offered as a structural resemblance to the quantum measurement problem — picking one flow takes a measurement — not as a claim that the lab is quantum mechanics.

Why 2026 did not promote the 2025 toys

W-state holonomy and the F-bound are finite, named-harness results. They do not rehabilitate Hofstadter-as-inflation-lattice, Rydberg Dataverse alignment, or ε* as a universal constant.
The Phase-N kits inject the echo they later “detect.” That is a protocol, not a blind holdout.
Grok-in-the-loop PASS on emulated traces is not IBM / Google Quantum AI / Rydberg-lab data.
The operational ε* is a joint-gate threshold on a designed metric bundle, then rewritten as a thermodynamic formula. Those are different claims.
V1688 “directed native holonomy” was withdrawn. The August W-state loop is a separate finite result and does not restore the visualizer claim.
